text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I walked past the cafeteria, I 
saw Copano Rickey and the others 
surrounded by a massive spread of chanko 
nabe.
choice_data_list:
W-What on earth is with... all this chanko 
nabe?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"In feng shui, seasonal ingredients are 
the foundation of good fortune♪ Plus, 
depending on which fortune you want to 
boost, there are recommended foods—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm, like what for example~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"First up... ingredients that boost 
financial luck! Fried tofu, eggs, and 
other yellow foods are said to be great."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For health luck, go with green 
ingredients. Also, miso soup is the 
ultimate dish that boosts your overall 
luck across the board!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's amazing! Maybe it'd taste 
great if I used this to make miso-flavored 
chanko~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a great idea! Since we have 
the chance, let's make it together~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —And so, I went ahead and made one!
choice_data_list: Even so, that's an incredible amount...
Even so, that's an incredible amount...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but having lots of them just 
means it's that much more super happy☆!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, big things are good things, and 
good luck is a good thing too, so that's 
Buono and happy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it brings Buono happiness, it 
still feels like way too much food for 
just a few people...
choice_data_list:
Let's share some of this good fortune with 
everyone!
Eat plenty and bring on great fortune!!

Eat a whole lot and bring on the best of 
luck!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it brings Buono happiness, it 
still feels like way too much food for 
just a few people...
choice_data_list:
Let's share some of this good fortune with 
everyone!
Eat plenty and bring on great fortune!!

Eat a whole lot and bring on the best of 
luck!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well said! You definitely have to 
share happy things with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're currently serving up lucky dishes! 
If you're hungry, come grab a bite and 
fill yourself with good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Serving... good-luck-bringing food...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oguri-san! Care to eat some good luck 
food and find some happiness!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, I would gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we shared the chanko nabe with 
everyone (mainly Oguri Cap) and happily 
devoured every last bite.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Both our tummies and our fortune are 
stuffed full~☆ Well then, time to eat!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... *huff, puff*...! 
Akebono's chanko really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, pure happiness is filling 
up my stomach! Alright, time for bowl 
number seven~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Copano Rickey managed to finish 
the entire meal. Though too full to move 
for a while, this is sure to bring immense 
good fortune... right...?
